$comment: Web Search Plus 5.0.1 example config. Source-only search routing plus extraction. Automatic routing picks the first provider by query type; provider_priority orders the fallback chain.

locale.$comment: Default country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) and language (ISO 639-1, or 'auto' to send the query's detected language) for providers with locale parameters (Serper, Brave, Querit, Firecrawl, You.com, SearXNG). Location hints in the query (e.g. 'restaurantes Madrid') override the country. Env: WSP_LOCALE_COUNTRY / WSP_LOCALE_LANGUAGE.

serpbase.$comment: SerpBase is explicit/fallback-only: it is never picked first by automatic routing unless auto_routing.auto_allow.serpbase is true.

keenable.$comment: Keenable is last in the fallback order. allow_public=true opts in to the keyless shared public tier (no SLA); WSP_KEENABLE_ALLOW_PUBLIC=1 or KEENABLE_ALLOW_PUBLIC=1 works too.

web.$comment: Inline characters per extracted page before the head/tail window (WSP_EXTRACT_CHAR_LIMIT overrides).

quality.$comment: Extra spam/mirror domains to remove from results, and domains to rescue from the builtin blocklist (exact domain or true subdomains only).
